title_name: Radeon on Sale at Today's Price
hook: {count} Radeon cards, each with its own price. Which one is actually worth it today?
loop: Stay to the end, one card is the clear pick.

gone.narration: The RX 7700 XT, 7800 XT and 7900 cards are gone: they only come inside full PCs.

takeaway.narration: Pay a little more for the XT, and skip eight gigabytes.

items.label: RX 7600
items.line: The RX 7600 costs {price} and has eight old gigabytes.

items.label: RX 9060 XT 8GB
items.line: The 9060 XT with eight gigabytes is {price}. Not enough memory.

items.label: RX 9060 XT 16GB
items.line: The sixteen gigabyte 9060 XT costs {price}, the sweet spot.

items.label: RX 9070 GRE
items.line: The RX 9070 GRE has twelve gigabytes for {price}, barely less than a 16 GB card.

items.label: RX 9070
items.line: The RX 9070 costs {price} with sixteen gigabytes.

items.label: RX 9070 XT
items.line: And the RX 9070 XT is {price}, only a little more. The clear pick.
